name: Kaitasume: Zero
storyline:
If you were the victim of a twisted and unjust world, would you be able to make a change?

Follow the protagonist everyone calls "demon" on his descent into madness when his online friend suggests he summon higher beings and break reality as they know it.

You'll discover alongside him how cruel children and adults can be, and you'll be able to decide between cruelty or mercy.

Will you hurt those who have hurt you, or will you prefer to be better than them and stand up to make a change?
